read: The morning's risk-on tone has faded rather than flipped: SPY at 765.70 is only +0.04% on the day and QQQ at 714.62 is +0.34%, both slightly below their 9:30 opens (-0.21% and -0.07%) and SPY under its 767.05 premarket print, with QQQ about level with its 714.79 premarket print (this morning's premarket percentages were measured against the wrong close; the real gap up was about +0.2% for SPY and +0.4% for QQQ). The VIX is lower at 17.77 (-3.4%), the 10-year yield has edged up to 5.00%, and WTI is slightly lower near $101.24, flat since the open. There is still no U.S. red event today (calendar check failed this run; the morning list had only Australian CPI at 8:30 PM ET and the RBNZ decision at 9:00 PM ET), and the Fed meeting that started today is the week's main event.
